Market today: The mood is cautious, leaning negative. Rising rate hike chances from Jackson Hole comments are the real driver, causing US stock futures to slip. Geopolitical tensions in Ukraine and the Middle East add to the uncertainty, which hurts growth/tech names.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down 56.25% and a leveraged SELL. SPAL, a new leveraged position, is already down 38.81%. SMH is also a TRIM at -13.08%. Remember, trading on margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on geopolitical developments and any further Fed commentary. Crucially, respect your stops on all positions, especially the leveraged ones.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management and capital preservation in this uncertain environment.
plays: Seriously consider exiting SOXL. It's a leveraged ETF, down 56.25%, and marked SELL.
Review SPAL. It's a new, leveraged position already down 38.81% and decays quickly.
Trim SMH if it breaks its stop at 540. This chip ETF is currently down 13.08%.
